changelog: Core Principles: strengthened the 'avoid premature commitment' rule to explicitly delay finalizing noun phrases, prenominal/genitive modifiers, enumerations, subject-only fragments (～が), adverbials, temporal/scope modifiers, verb clusters, agent/person/tense assignments and polarity until disambiguating heads/predicates/counters/negators/list-closers appear.

When to Segment: merged measured candidate rules into the disambiguator list and added explicit surface indicators to flag prenominal modifiers, incomplete enumerations, subject-only fragments, temporal/adverbial modifiers, and verb-cluster splits as risky (lower confidence) positions unless a clear disambiguator has already appeared.

Priority Rules: consolidated multiple candidate_rules into the demotions/special cautions: strongly demote (but do not forbid) cuts that would finalize quantity/extent before counters/quantifiers, separate modifiers from their heads, split enumerations or name lists, assert existence/polarity from a subject-only fragment, or break verb-complement chains; prefer promoting only when a clear disambiguator or sealed clause is present.

Decision Procedure: added explicit candidate-flagging for trailing prenominal modifiers, incomplete name/enumeration lists, subject-only ～が fragments, temporal/adverbial modifiers, and verb-cluster/object splits; require these flagged candidates to be demoted unless an explicit disambiguator (predicate/negation, counter, case particle completing a noun, closing quote, or list-close token) is already present before promotion to high confidence.
